item.description: Melmachos #5798 the Blood-handed was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Burning Lake of Eridanus's freedom). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown. Melmachos has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.
